Actual installed RLIB, exact std Cargo manifest (included backtrace dependency), library lock checksum; upstream archive license agrees with installed HTML after removing HTML-added surrounding whitespace.
Bound PDB RLIB, std manifest and exact library lock; its upstream MIT bytes are identical to cfg-if 1.0.4 and reused without notice loss.
Bound PDB RLIB, exact library lock/archive; std uses default-features=false and rustc-dep-of-std.

selection.version: 0.1.160 in the Rust commit, not app Cargo.lock
selection.license_expression: MIT AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND (MIT OR Apache-2.0)
selection.evidence: Bound PDB compiler_builtins archive and object/source references; full upstream combined text includes LLVM exception and historical attribution. Complete text is retained instead of relying on embedding exceptions to remove a notice.

selection.version: libm manifest 0.2.16 in same Rust source tree; not separate app dependency

selection.selected: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception; MIT alternative for legacy dual-licensed material
selection.evidence: Installed compiler_builtins RLIB includes 35 native-named builtins objects. Rust source build.rs selects compiler-rt source under RUST_COMPILER_RT_ROOT, matching Rust's pinned llvm-project family. Supplemental complete upstream file retained, including original legacy alternatives. No claim all 35 objects or LLVM itself are in the EXE.

exclusions.reason: Exact std Cargo.toml excludes ordinary windows-msvc-pc; application dependencies may independently include these crates and retain their separate selection.
Different platform branches, not the selected x86_64-pc-windows-msvc standard-library path.

hashbrown default-hasher is disabled; rustc-dep-of-std activates nightly whose foldhash?/nightly edge is weak. No foldhash RLIB in installed Windows std component. This excludes only std's hashbrown instance.

Presence in the multi-target source/build copyright bundle or installed test/compiler support is not evidence of application runtime inclusion. No such std RLIB path in the bound PDB scan; the production build has no tests/profile instrumentation override. This is not a whole dependency-tree exclusion.

Exact library/unwind/src/lib.rs selects an empty extra-unwinder branch for target_env=msvc. panic_unwind SEH source is positively referenced in the EXE; MSVC runtime selection remains outside this package.

outputs.kind: authored attribution index; original copyright names retained

reproduction.program_format: Node CommonJS stdin, from repository root; local installed jsdom used only for non-executing HTML parsing. Source writer permits only absent or byte-identical named output files; no package installation or build.
probe_history: Initial PDB magic comparison used a 24-byte slice; failed MSF7 guard. Corrected to exact 32-byte magic, then actual GUID and age passed.
Initial archive long-name decoding assumed newline termination; Windows COFF names are NUL-terminated. Corrected before using member classifications; 35 native-named entries reported.

Initial and whitespace-only-adjusted HTML traversal both failed because DETAILS elements are siblings of the closed P element. Corrected sibling handling; all three archive MIT texts then matched installed index. Already written original texts were accepted only after byte-equality checks.
reproduction.validation: Three locked crate archive SHA-256 checks, three matching local-index MIT texts, all eight upstream output files exact source/member bytes, authored attribution index separately labelled. No production tests or rebuild.

remaining: Integrate these nine texts into the final Windows selection and copy/check them in the actual license payload.
Pin/check Rust release commit and target plus stdlib inputs for any future native build; this record is not an automatic approval after toolchain/target/flags changes.
MSVC, WebView2, installer payload and other license-delivery work remain outside this package.
